definitions.short: a pail or jar (for drawing water)
definitions.full: H1805. deli דְּלִי noun [masculine] bucket , מִדְּלִי כְּמַר like a drop (hanging) from a bucket Isa 40:15 ; Du suffix מִדָּֽלְיָו מים יזל Num 24:7 compare Di (on form doly¹w compare Ew § 180 a & Anm. 3 , also Sta § 52 a ); figurative of Israel's prosperity.
